description: This file contains utility methods related to Android system version checks and enabling strict mode debugging features. It provides static methods to verify the current Android SDK version and to enable strict mode policies for detecting issues during development.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for Android version checks and enabling strict mode policies.

methods.name: enableStrictMode
methods.description: Configures and enables strict mode policies for thread and VM to assist in catching performance and correctness issues during development.

methods.name: hasFroyo
methods.description: Checks if the current Android version is Froyo (API level 8) or higher.

methods.name: hasGingerbread
methods.description: Checks if the current Android version is Gingerbread (API level 9) or higher.

methods.name: hasHoneycomb
methods.description: Checks if the current Android version is Honeycomb (API level 11) or higher.

methods.name: hasHoneycombMR1
methods.description: Checks if the current Android version is Honeycomb MR1 (API level 12) or higher.

methods.name: hasJellyBean
methods.description: Checks if the current Android version is Jelly Bean (API level 16) or higher.

methods.name: hasKitKat
methods.description: Checks if the current Android version is KitKat (API level 19) or higher.
